Anya: rolling the hybrid-q4f candidate (v3.2f) into a 10% canary for the legal-reranker route. quick sanity check pls :eyes:
Ravi: thanks — can you paste the baseline vs candidate numbers?
Anya: baseline v3.1 -> rouge-L 0.435, halluc_rate 0.7%, MRR@10 0.78, p95 latency 320ms
Anya: candidate v3.2f-q4 -> rouge-L 0.413, halluc_rate 1.6%, MRR@10 0.75, p95 latency 220ms
Jen: ugh hallucinations jumped ~+0.9pp (~2.3x relative). latency win is nice but QA for legal is strict.
Ravi: agree — we should not widen canary traffic until we triage slices. what are our automatic fallback rules currently?
Sam: current auto-fallback: absolute halluc_rate > 1.0% OR relative halluc_rate increase >50% OR MRR drop >3% across the canary window (5k reqs). auto-rollback triggers at both absolute+relative thresholds.
Anya: ml-ci-bot ran a quick smoke eval: "smoke: passed, halluc_rate=1.5% (warn), rouge-L delta -0.022 (fail threshold -0.01), latency improved"
ml-ci-bot: [bot] detailed smoke output: top-slices with regression -> legal-contracts, legal-citations, citations-longform. sample replay recommended.
Jen: proposal: pause expansion at 10%, start targeted replay on the 3 slices (10k samples each), and add a temporary canary policy: if halluc_rate on any safety slice >1.0% OR MRR drop >2% we auto-fallback to v3.1 immediately and notify #incidents.
Ravi: +1. Also add a soft guard that prevents expansion beyond 10% unless slice-level halluc deltas <0.3pp for 24h. pushes rollback config to canary-config: --canary=10% --slices=[legal-contracts,legal-citations,citations-longform] --auto-fallback="abs_hall>1.0% or rel_hall>50% or mrr_drop>2%"
Anya: I'll kick off the replays and pin the canary to 10%. tagging @Jen for eval handoff. will post updated numbers in ~2h. :thumbsup:
Sam: sounds good. if smoke-replay confirms halluc_rate >2% we should plan an immediate rollback and a deep-dive.
Jen: noted. also add a metric alert for halluc_rate trend slope >+0.2pp/hr to the canary dashboard.
Anya: created ticket IR-4234 for the triage and dashboard changes. leaving canary live at 10% until replay completes.
